facts.fact: The National Digital Transformation Council, chaired by Deputy Prime Minister Temesgen Tiruneh, met and was said to provide strategic leadership for the Digital Ethiopia Strategy, reviewing its implementation and the alignment of new digital initiatives with it.

The Council reviewed progress on the Digital Ethiopia Strategy, Fayda and the 5 Million Coders initiative and the Deputy Prime Minister said success should be measured by lives improved; no target, indicator or published report is given.

systems.owner: Government of Ethiopia, chaired by the Deputy Prime Minister
